title: dedicated-autoscaler: tokenbucket smoothing, burst controls, throughput guarantees, and utilization reporting
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add token-bucket smoothing, configurable burst caps, per-fleet throughput guarantees, and improved utilization reporting for Dedicated Autoscaler. Motivated by customer incidents where short microbursts exhausted token buckets causing cascading queueing and autoscaler thrash. Main changes: (1) tokenbucket: introduce smoothing window and adjustable refill granularity to prevent microbursts from depleting capacity; (2) burst_control: add per-fleet configurable max_burst_tokens and sustained_burst_rate with runtime enforcement and dynamic fallback when capacity is constrained; (3) throughput_guarantees: new SLA-aware allocation that reserves concurrency slots to satisfy declared throughput guarantees and emits guarantee_violation events for monitoring/alerting; (4) telemetry: instrument Prometheus metrics (autoscaler_tokenbucket_tokens, autoscaler_burst_rejections_total, dedicated_fleet_throughput_guaranteed, dedicated_fleet_utilization_percent) and add Grafana dashboards and alert rules; (5) reporting: per-fleet daily utilization CSV report and an admin API to query historical utilization and quota headroom; (6) rollout: feature-flag gated (dedicated.autoscaler.v2.enabled) with canary rollout plan and automated migration that preserves existing defaults. Also includes unit, integration and load tests plus a small operator-facing doc on tuning burst caps. Related Linear tickets ENG-9412 and ENG-9853 were used as acceptance criteria. Checklist: - design doc reviewed and linked - unit tests added and passing - integration tests added and passing - load test stability verified on perf-canary cluster - telemetry dashboards and alerts added - docs/upgrade notes included.
